TAT elevates 125th Ubon Ratchathani Candle Procession as Signature Thailand Event

TAT elevates the 125th Ubon Ratchathani Candle Procession as a Signature Thailand Event, running from 25–31 July 2026. The landmark festival combines Buddhist traditions and intricate candle craftsmanship with light-and-sound performances, hands-on art activities, illuminated displays, Nong Mamuang sculptures and parades featuring thousands of performers across Ubon Ratchathani during this edition.
